title: RAG Evaluation - The Broken Help Center
goal: Measure the baseline performance of a help center RAG system and produce a comprehensive evaluation report.

introduction.title: Measure What's Broken
body: The support bot has lost its memory. The docs are noisy. Retrieval is cursed.
Nobody knows whether it finds the right articles, where it fails, or whether the team should trust it.
Your quest is to turn the cursed vibes into a measurable baseline.
No fancy agents. No dashboards. No optimization yet. First, prove what the current retriever can and cannot do.

dataset.name: Broken Help Center
dataset.description: Internal help center documents and support queries
notes: Includes help center articles and support queries
Data is noisy and unstructured, reflecting real-world challenges
Analysis outputs should go to analysis/

levels.hard: Strict review with deep analysis of metrics and insights.

milestones.title: Setup & Orientation
milestones.short_description: Initialize the quest and understand the help center structure.
milestones.long_description: Run the BuildGuild game setup, choose your difficulty level, and explore the help center data structure. Understand what documents and queries you're working with.

tasks.title: Explore the help center data structure

milestones.title: Build Baseline Retriever
milestones.short_description: Implement a simple retrieval baseline for the help center.
milestones.long_description: Build a baseline retriever that ranks help center documents against support queries. This should be a simple approach (e.g., BM25, TF-IDF, or basic embedding similarity) without complex optimizations.

milestones.title: Evaluate & Analyze
milestones.short_description: Evaluate retriever performance with quantitative metrics.
milestones.long_description: Calculate retrieval metrics (recall@k, NDCG, MRR) and analyze where the retriever succeeds and fails. Identify patterns in successful vs failed retrievals.

tasks.title: Analyze failure cases and success patterns

milestones.title: Produce Final Report
milestones.short_description: Create a comprehensive baseline report with findings and recommendations.
milestones.long_description: Compile all findings into a clear report with metrics, success/failure examples, and recommendations for the next steps in optimizing the help center retriever.
